details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4, K5, K6, and K7 are all PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K3 is MISSING because there is no mention of segment performance for flight package tours or sightseeing tours by plane, including sales changes and gross profit margin comparisons. The summary captures most high-importance financial and operational metrics, but the absence of K3’s detailed segment performance means the overall coverage is generally good but not complete.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overarching narrative of prioritizing profitability despite declining sales volumes. There are no self-contradictions: the summary consistently explains how reduced sales volumes were offset by improved margins and operational efficiencies. The organization flows logically from revenue and volume declines to profitability improvements, then to specific financial metrics, and finally to strategic context and balance sheet changes. While there is a mention of covenant breaches (S15), this does not create an internal contradiction because the summary does not claim full compliance with all covenants nor does it assert that compliance was maintained throughout the period. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between figures (e.g., lower sales with higher margins) are logically explained within the text.
